370:
- The war room is a clan-based strategy game within Straw Hat Samurai: Duels.

- After joining a clan, you can may select an on-going battle to take part in.

- On-going battles will be marked on the war room map with your clan's flag.

- Once the battle is selected, select the sector with your clan's command HQ and select the "MOVE" action to enter the battlefield.
372:
- Each turn, every player gets a number of  moves based on their rank.

- Moves can be used to deploy troops, attack enemy troops, move to a different sector, spy on the enemy or build structures.

- Most moves can only be used on sectors adjacent to the player that are not blocked.

- if the adjacent sector is blocked, the player may only fire arrows are it. Arrows will kill a random number of enemy troops and also deter the construction of enemy structures.

- the effect of moves is dependent on the terrain. mountains have the highest tactical advantage, followed by forests and fields.

- the clan will pay the player 5 coins per move made.
374:
- when you select the "attack" or "defend" action, you will personally fight against the enemy troops.

- if enemy players are present in the sector, you will also encounter them during battle.

- defeating enemy players will remove them from the sector and kick them off the battlefield.
376:
- use the "deploy troops" action to increase the number of troops in a sector.

- Troops will advance on enemy sectors every 24 hours.

- If a sector has more attacking troops than defending troops, the sector will be captured by the attackers.

- The Clan that captures all the control points in the battlefield will gain control of the territory.
378:
- your rank is based on the number of moves that you have made.

- donating coins to build structures will also help you rise in rank faster.

- higher ranking players will have more moves per turn and will also be able to perform special actions.

- Officers are able to initiate the building of structures while Generals are able to build command hqs in territories that are adjacent to friendly territories.

-Players will receive clan equipment whenever they gain a war rank.
380:
- Once the contruction of a structure is initiated by an Officer, any friendly player will be able to help build the structure by contributing 500 coins to the sector.

- Firing arrows at enemy structures while they are being constructed will hinder their progress.
